0 · Live SAP feed (required — from the SAP Live Fetch extension)

How to get & use the SAP Live Fetch extension (v0.1 — developer preview)
Install (unpacked):
  1. Get the l4-sap-extension folder from the L4 handoff package (also shipped as l4-sap-extension.zip — unzip it first).
  2. Open chrome://extensions (or edge://extensions) and switch on Developer mode (top-right).
  3. Click Load unpacked and select the l4-sap-extension folder. Pin the extension, then click its icon to open the side panel. (Browsers don't allow installing an extension straight from a web link, so this one-time manual load is expected.)
Use:
  1. Log into SAP for Me in the same browser (your normal SSO/MFA). The panel's top card should read “SAP for Me session: Active ✓”. No password or token is stored — it only borrows the session you're already signed into.
  2. From the panel, open Process Navigator (scope) and Roadmap Viewer (methodology), and click into a few scope items / roadmap tasks so the extension can capture the pages' own data endpoints.
  3. Use Export (JSON) / Fetch live in the panel to pull the data, then return here and use Choose File below to import the resulting L4_scenario_bundle.json.
Status — please note: v0.1 is a discovery / proof build. It reliably captures and replays SAP's own endpoints, but the step that maps that live data into a ready-to-import L4_scenario_bundle.json is still being wired in — so a fully automated one-click pull isn't guaranteed yet. It can only read what your SAP access already allows, and it stores nothing but endpoint URLs plus small response samples (no credentials).
Download SAP Live Fetch extension (.zip) — then unzip and load it via chrome://extensions → Developer mode → Load unpacked (steps above).
Gap-filling runs automatically on Generate (Live → Library → AI-flagged): the Agent estimates effort for off-library items and drafts config/UT steps for [detail pending] items, then builds. Needs an Anthropic API key or the app running inside Claude; otherwise those items fall back to the flagged heuristic / “detail pending” line. AI output is tagged [AI-est] / [AI-draft] — verify before baseline.

Ground Rules — how the Agent decides (source of truth, sizing, phase model)

1 · Phase durations — SAP Community experience standard ranges (Prepare 12–14 / Explore 22–25 / Realize 44–48 / Deploy 16–18%; Discover & Run excluded). Community-derived, not SAP-published (only the Large threshold is official). The schedule anchors on the midpoints; a phase only flags overrun once effort exceeds the top of its band.

2 · Project size — auto-classified Small / Medium / Large from the highest band triggered by any of scope items, countries, or users.

3 · Live SAP vs library (source of truth) — when the two disagree, the Agent shows both and flags the difference — it never silently picks. By data type:

Data Wins Why
Cross-SID dependenciesLiveAvailability file is authoritative & richer
Identity, LOB, description, country availability, deprecationLiveOnly live has it, and it's current
Config activitiesLibrary (until live proves richer)Live generic SSCUI file is sparse
UT activitiesLive where a test script exists, else pendingLive test scripts fetchable per item
Effort / durations (days)Library → AI-est [flagged]SAP publishes no effort anywhere

Everything estimated is labelled [AI-est] / [approx]; genuine gaps become pending, never invented.

1 · Project inputs

Enter the project start date. The end date (target go-live) is optional — leave it blank for a pure bottom-up finish, or enter it to see whether the plan fits. The tool computes all phase dates for you.

2 · Project shape (Prepare / Explore / Deploy)

Turn a tag ON to include that variant’s extra tasks in Prepare / Explore / Deploy; OFF leaves them out. This only shapes those three phases — it never changes the Realize build or the SIT/UAT test spine. Core (untagged) tasks are always kept. Ticked tags are on by default — leave the defaults if unsure.

3 · Scope Item IDs

3b · Add library rows for unknown Scope IDs

For scope IDs not in the built-in 259-item library, supply their details here so the Agent can schedule them. Three ways — use whichever is convenient. Core fields required: Config Activities, Config Days, UT Activities, UT Days.

AI review & co-pilot THINKS OVER YOUR PLAN

The engine above owns every number. The AI reasons over this exact plan, the real library records, and the rules — it flags issues, or (co-pilot) proposes adjustments the engine must recompute. Works when this tool runs inside Claude.

Without a key, the in-Claude route caps the AI response length, so long plans stop partway (e.g. around Explore). Paste a key (used only in your browser) to get the full end-to-end proposal. The engine's own “Download L4 Plan (Excel)” above is always complete and deterministic.
